decisions: The actual source indicator is a role=status SVG with a default Loading name. Reference usage supplies the task-specific Loading contacts name. The default16px size and12/20/24px source specimens map to explicit caller classes, not an invented public size prop. The source icon adapter chooses a vendor glyph; canonical SVG is a semantic icon projection, not a claim that native path bytes match all vendors. A chosen1s rotation expresses animate-spin; reduced-motion removes movement while preserving named status.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
